gaps (non-blocking, top three):
1. Missing: nothing in this repo enabled the holyagent plugin. At session start .claude/settings.json had no enabledPlugins or marketplace (condensed 279-289). CLAUDE.md does not point to the root prompt, which reaches a session only through the plugin, so the session ran with no root text (condensed 209, 510). The hotfix added the settings later.
2. Contradicted or unresolved: holyagent.md line 37 says every workflow agent is `holyagent:<agent>`, and that direct subagents are the fallback only when Workflow is disabled or unavailable. It does not say what to do when those agent types do not resolve, which was the case at condensed 187. The root chose the Agent fallback silently and repeated it for all 10 launches.
3. Missing: lines 59-61 list `detect, commit, push, branch, pr, ci` with no route for merge, git identity, stash or state repair. The root then used gh, git config, git stash and git checkout on .holyagent (V5). Line 13 says "the user's language" without the "latest language used" rule the user had to supply (raw line 774), and the messaging rule is buried mid-paragraph in line 31.
